name: Neural Deformation Field
definition: A neural network F_Δ that predicts per-point displacement Δ in canonical space to accommodate non-rigid deformation, conditioned on target pose θt and signed height h̃.
summary: Neural Deformation Field models non-rigid deformations in neural radiance fields by predicting per-point displacements, distinguishing itself by decoupling rigid skeletal transformations from residual neural displacements.
